title: SCA Minhag of the Week 171 "Tefilla BeSibbur: Arbit Mosa'e Shabbat Until Amida"

chapters.title: Introduction to Motzaei Shabbat Arvit
chapters.about: Minhagim of Arvit on Motzaei Shabbat

summary: Mr. Harari discusses the customs for Arvit on Motzaei Shabbat in the synagogue. He details the specific Mizmorim, the timing for starting the prayer, and the musical scales used by the Hazzan.
questions: What Mizmorim are recited before Arvit on Motzaei Shabbat?
When is the traditional time to begin Arvit on Motzaei Shabbat?
Does the Hazzan repeat the last pasuk before Kaddish on Motzaei Shabbat?
What musical scale is typically used for the Arvit Kaddish?
Why do people say Atah Chonantanu out loud during the Amidah?
